aliases: RecipeDia - A New Recipe Discovery Experience
abstract: This project is aimed at developing a website that suggests recipes to the user based on the ingredients the user has indicated that they have. Users can create and log into their own personal accounts and their personal database will be created which contains all the information regarding the ingredients they have selected. Once they have logged in, the user is able to indicate what ingredients they currently have. Once they have finished selecting all the ingredients that they have, the website will then show a list of all the dishes that are able to be made from the ingredients that the user has indicated they have.

abstract: In this report we discuss the purpose behind the project we have chosen, the methods used, the implications applied and the results we have acquired for our senior project 1. Throughout the years, we have seen students of ABAC building many projects for the university, but not all of them have been an engaging project targeting the visitors of ABAC and also realizing very few have used the concept of Augmented Reality, we saw this as an opportunity to build something in this concentration. Using tools such as Lightship Augmented Reality Developer Kit (ARDK), which gives developers the tools they need to create immersive, multiplayer experiences and bring them to life in the real world, and Unity Game Engine, which is a beginner friendly tool that can be used to create three-dimensional (3D) and two-dimensional (2D) games, as well as interactive simulations and other experiences, for this project we created three interactive games which could be played in three different locations of Assumption University, Bangna Campus.

canonical_title: Deliverit: An Android Application for Truck Delivery Service.
aliases: Deliverit : An android Application for Truck Delivery Services
abstract: Not to mention Nowadays Mobile Applications have become a daily part of our lives. When it comes to delivery of any type, applications have become a necessity. It is pretty common for people to use apps for ordering food, travelling and moving in and out of houses. That's where my app comes in. My App Deliverit is a mobile Application that helps people do deliveries from places. It not only helps people have types of truck services but is a way for private drivers to make an extra income. Big industries can use my application for properly maintaining their vehicles for delivery as well.
